product.title: Silver Springs Clear Kayak Manatee, Monkey & Wildlife Adventures

description.text: On this kayaking tour, you can look out for a variety of local wildlife, including manatees, monkeys, and birds. The all-clear kayak option provides an immersive experience, allowing you to see the underwater world clearly as you paddle. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
